description: Source code for the DocumentGenerator class and related functions used to generate project documentation, clone repositories, and create mkdocs configuration files.

classes.name: MkdocsYamlFileGenerator
classes.description: Class responsible for generating mkdocs YAML configuration files for documentation.

classes.name: DocumentGenerator
classes.description: Main class for managing repository cloning, documentation generation, and index file creation.

methods.name: create_site_details
methods.description: Writes site name and URL to the mkdocs YAML file.

methods.name: add_nav_tag
methods.description: Adds navigation tag to the YAML configuration.

methods.name: add_topic
methods.description: Adds a topic section to the YAML configuration.

methods.name: add_subtopic
methods.description: Adds a subtopic under a topic in the YAML configuration.

methods.name: create_topics
methods.description: Initializes a new topic in the YAML structure.

methods.name: create_subtopics
methods.description: Adds a subtopic to the current topic.

methods.name: create_file
methods.description: Generates the mkdocs YAML file with all topics and subtopics.

methods.name: add_theme_info
methods.description: Adds theme and markdown extension info to the YAML file.

methods.name: is_branch_name_valid
methods.description: Validates the branch name against a semantic version pattern.

methods.name: clean_all_repos_dir
methods.description: Removes existing repository directories before cloning.

methods.name: clone_all_repos
methods.description: Clones all required repositories for documentation.

methods.name: clone_repo
methods.description: Clones a specific repository and returns commit ID and date.

methods.name: mkdocs_create_index_file
methods.description: Creates the main index.md file for mkdocs with repository info.

methods.name: add_topic
methods.description: Adds a documentation topic and its files to the YAML generator.

methods.name: to_markdown
methods.description: Converts interface files to markdown using an external script.

methods.name: complete_yaml_creation
methods.description: Finalizes and writes the YAML configuration file.
